label: NORA-B20-B21-B22 (Nordic nRF54L15/L10/L05)
pending_reason: Bluetooth LE needs no u-blox calibration table; the nRF54L trim values ship in FICR and the Nordic HAL applies them. What is still manual is the public Bluetooth device address and the TX power setting - see manual_steps.

notes: Replace PLUS_4 with the required output power. Account for antenna gain; see the NORA-B20-B21-B22 system integration manual, Regulatory compliance.

mac.source: Public Bluetooth device address in UICR OTP, programmed in u-blox production
notes: NCS samples default to the static random address derived from FICR, not the u-blox public address.

manual_steps: To use the programmed public address, read it from UICR and call bt_ctlr_set_public_addr() before bt_enable(). See u-blox application note UBX-19055303, 'Using public IEEE address from UICR'.
